desc: Implement the core DP: maintain `cnt[d]` as a list of remainder frequencies (size d) for all substrings ending at current position, for each d in 1..9.
On each new character x, for every d, build new remainder counts: new_r = (r*10 + x) % d for existing suffixes, plus the single-digit suffix x % d; this costs O(d) per d per character.
If current digit x != 0, add cnt[x][0] to the answer (substrings ending here with value ≡ 0 mod x).
Verify against the three examples ("12936" → 11, "5701283" → 18, "1010101010" → 25) and edge cases: all zeros, single character, leading zeros.
Analyze complexity (O(n·45) time, O(45) space) and confirm it fits n = 10^5; write final code in the starter class.
